# Field Notes on Coastal Observation

## Introduction

This neutral fixture exercises headings, ordinary paragraphs, *emphasis*,
**strong text**, block quotations, lists, and footnotes without relying on
copyrighted source material.

> Careful observation begins with a useful distinction between what is seen
> and what is inferred.

- A measured observation is recorded with its units.
- An interpretation is marked as an interpretation.

## Method

The observer records the tide, wind, and cloud cover at regular intervals.[^1]
The resulting notes are short enough to compare across editions.
